items.seed_question: Which is the real Thailand Digital Arrival Card?

items.markdown:
The official website for the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) is the `Thai Immigration Bureau Portal` . All non-Thai nationals must use this free portal to complete their mandatory arrival form within 3 days prior to entering the country.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=65bb7713d0737318de2bab23) [[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=65bb7713d0737318de2bab23)[[2]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/content/thailand-digital-arrival-card-tdac-required-from-1?cate=5d6636c215e39c3bd0006cb7)

Registration Details

- **Cost:** Free of charge (beware of scam/third-party sites charging fees).
- **Deadline:** Submit within 3 days (72 hours) before arrival.
- **Requirement:** Mandatory for all foreign visitors regardless of visa type or exemption status.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=65bb7713d0737318de2bab23) [[1]](https://thailandinsider.com/plan-your-trip/)

Required Information

- **Personal Data:** Full name, nationality, contact details, and passport information.
- **Travel Data:** Flight or transport number, travel purpose, and address in Thailand (such as a hotel).[](https://www.katathani.com/news/thailand-digital-arrival-card/) [[1]](https://www.katathani.com/news/thailand-digital-arrival-card/)
